features: Rugged Polycarbonate Build: Lightweight yet durable polycarbonate body designed to withstand daily training intensity and outdoor use
Scratch-resistant Glass: Durable display glass that resists scratches, keeping visuals clear and protected
3.68 cm (1.46 inch) AMOLED Display: Big, bright screen with vivid detail and glance-ready visibility
600 Nits Brightness: Ensures clarity under direct sunlight, making stats easy to read outdoors
3-axis Sensors: Tracks every stride, shift, and motion with accuracy for consistent activity and fitness insights
ABC Sensors: Altitude Tracking, Air Pressure Sensor & True Compass to keep you prepared for every terrain and condition
5ATM Water Resistance: Protected against rain, splashes, and moisture so your training continues in every condition
